map.=100−60=40 元，保本销量=40000/40=1000 件；当月销量超过: of 100−60 = 40 CNY and a break-even volume of 40000/40 = 1000 units; profit only begins above 1000 units a month.
map.保本销量=固定成本÷(单价−单位变动成本)，分母即单位边际贡献；保本金额=固定成: Break-even volume = fixed cost ÷ (unit price − unit variable cost), where the denominator is the unit contribution margin; break-even sales value = fixed cost ÷ contribution margin ratio.
map.边际贡献率是什么？: What is the contribution margin ratio?
map.边际贡献率=单位边际贡献÷单价，反映每元销售收入中可用于覆盖固定成本并盈利的比例: The contribution margin ratio = unit contribution margin ÷ unit price, showing the share of each yuan of sales available to cover fixed costs and generate profit.
map.盈亏平衡量(件) = 固定成本 ÷ (单价 − 单位变动成本)；平衡销售额 =: Break-even quantity (units) = fixed cost ÷ (unit price − unit variable cost); break-even sales = break-even quantity × unit price; unit contribution margin = unit price − unit variable cost. Validation: fixed cost, unit price and unit variable cost are required (required-field validation shell); the code does not check that unit price > variable cost, and when the two are equal the division-by-zero result is shown as —. Rule: a finite break-even point exists only when the unit contribution margin > 0, and a higher fixed cost or lower contribution margin means a larger break-even quantity (shown to 1 decimal place).
map.理论盈亏平衡量 = 固定成本 ÷ (单价 − 单位变动成本)；最少整数销量 =: Theoretical break-even quantity = fixed cost ÷ (unit price − unit variable cost); minimum whole units = ⌈theoretical break-even quantity⌉; minimum sales at whole units = minimum whole units × unit price. Validation: all three fields are required and finite; fixed cost and unit variable cost are non-negative and unit price is >0. When unit contribution is ≤0 the page states that no break-even point exists. Rule: divisible goods may use the theoretical value; goods sold by the piece must round up, and only sales at whole units fully cover fixed cost.
map.某产品单价 100 元、单位变动成本 60 元、月固定成本 40000 元，单位: A product sells for 100 CNY with unit variable cost 60 CNY and monthly fixed cost 40,000 CNY, so unit contribution is 40 CNY and theoretical break-even sales are 1,000 units. If the theoretical value is 1,000.4 units, piece sales need at least 1,001 units, and minimum sales = 1,001×100 = 100,100 CNY.
map.理论保本销量=固定成本÷(单价−单位变动成本)，分母即单位边际贡献；按件销售须向: Theoretical break-even quantity = fixed cost ÷ (unit price − unit variable cost), where the denominator is unit contribution. Piece sales must round up to the minimum whole units, and minimum sales = whole units × unit price.
map.为什么理论值和整数销量要分开？: Why are the theoretical value and whole units shown separately?
map.理论值允许小数，适合可分割商品；按件销售不能卖半件，必须向上取整，整数销量对应的: The theoretical value allows fractions for divisible goods; piece sales cannot sell half a unit, so they must round up, and only sales at whole units fully cover fixed cost.
